name: concord-engine
description: Scale parallelism. Preserve alignment. A fleet of coding agents builds one task in parallel against a spec contract, and a decision that contradicts one already in force is refused — deterministically, with no model in the decision path.

decisions_dir.title: Decision log directory
decisions_dir.description: Where decisions and conflicts are stored. Defaults to .concord-engine in the project. Commit it — the log is the shared contract.
